_meta.description: Known-infrastructure domain lists: one index per list (redelk-domainslist-redteam). Documents are written by modules/enrich_syncdomainslists as {@timestamp, domainslist:{name, source, domain, comment}} and enriched in place by modules/enrich_domainscategorization. The priority is above the redelk-* template because a composable index template does not merge with a lower priority one, it replaces it.
